indicators.section: Red Flag Indicators — Iran-backed terrorist orgs
indicators.flag: A customer or a customer’s counterparty conducts transactions with Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC)-designated entities and individuals, or transactions that contain a nexus to identifiers listed for OFAC-designated entities and individuals, to include email addresses, physical addresses, phone numbers, passport numbers, or CVC addresses.
indicators.red_flag: Counterparty or identifier nexus to OFAC-designated entity (incl. CVC address)
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C18 (Sanctions / watchlist screening).

indicators.section: Red Flag Indicators — Iran-backed terrorist orgs
indicators.flag: Information included in a transaction between customers or in a note accompanying a peer-to-peer transfer include key terms known to be associated with terrorism or terrorist organizations.
indicators.red_flag: Terrorism-associated key terms in P2P memo/narrative
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D5 (Transaction narrative / free-text fields), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.section: Red Flag Indicators — Iran-backed terrorist orgs
indicators.flag: A customer conducts transactions with a money services business (MSB) or other financial institution, including a VASP, that operates in jurisdictions known for, or at high risk for, terrorist activity and is reasonably believed to have lax customer identification and verification processes, opaque ownership, or otherwise fails to comply with AML/CFT best practices.
indicators.red_flag: Flow through high-risk-corridor MSB/VASP with lax CDD
indicators.rationale: Already covered by C20 (Cross-border / high-risk-jurisdiction & corridor anomaly detection).

indicators.section: Red Flag Indicators — Iran-backed terrorist orgs
indicators.flag: A customer conducts transactions that originate with, are directed to, or otherwise involve entities that are front companies, general “trading companies” with unclear business purposes, or other companies whose beneficial ownership information indicates that they may have a nexus with Iran or other Iran-supported terrorist groups.  Indicators of possible front companies include opaque ownership structures, individuals and/or entities with obscure names that direct the company, or business addresses that are residential or co-located with other companies.
indicators.red_flag: Front-company / opaque-UBO counterparty with Iran nexus
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data), not currently held → source data first.

build_logic.logic: Flag an entity exhibiting shell or front-company markers â opaque or circular beneficial ownership, shared registered addresses or directors, recent incorporation with no observable operations â escalating when nominees or addresses recur across a cluster of related entities.
build_logic.window: rolling 90 days over the ownership/address graph
build_logic.source: corporate registry + KYC beneficial-ownership records + entity-resolution graph
build_logic.route: Tier-2 network alert â AML investigations gate

indicators.section: Red Flag Indicators — Iran-backed terrorist orgs
indicators.flag: A customer that is or purports to be a charitable organization or NPO84  solicits donations but does not appear to provide any charitable services or openly supports terrorist activity or operations.  In some cases, these organizations may post on social media platforms or encrypted messaging apps to solicit donations, including in CVC.
indicators.red_flag: Sham-charity / NPO donation solicitation with no charitable output
indicators.rationale: Partially covered by C19 (Adverse-media / OSINT & web-presence verification); data D13.

indicators.section: Red Flag Indicators — Iran-backed terrorist orgs
indicators.flag: A customer receives numerous small CVC payments from many wallets, then transfers the funds to another wallet, particularly if the customer logs in using an Internet Protocol (IP) based in a jurisdiction known for, or at high risk for, terrorist activity.
indicators.red_flag: Multi-wallet CVC funnel-in then forward-out (terror-corridor IP)
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D7 (Virtual-currency / blockchain analytics), not currently held → source data first.

indicators.section: Red Flag Indicators — Iran-backed terrorist orgs
indicators.flag: A customer makes money transfers to a jurisdiction known for, or at high risk for, terrorist activity that are inconsistent with their stated occupation or business purpose with vague stated purposes such as “travel expenses,” “charity,” “aid,” or “gifts.
indicators.red_flag: Occupation-inconsistent transfers to terror corridor with vague stated purpose
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D3 (Wire / ACH / EFT & cross-border payment data (incl. EMT, P2P, remittance)), not currently held → source data first.

build_logic.logic: Flag a personal account whose inflow volume or wealth velocity is inconsistent with the customer's declared income, occupation, or stated source of funds, escalating when large credits lack a plausible origin for the customer's profile.
build_logic.window: rolling 90 days vs declared income profile
build_logic.source: personal deposit ledger joined to onboarding income/occupation KYC data
build_logic.route: Tier-1 alert â AML analyst review gate

indicators.section: Red Flag Indicators — Iran-backed terrorist orgs
indicators.flag: A customer account receives large payouts from social media fundraisers or crowdfunding platforms and is then accessed from an IP address in a jurisdiction known for, or at high risk for, terrorist activity, particularly if the social media accounts that contribute to the fundraisers contain content supportive of terrorist campaigns.
indicators.red_flag: Crowdfunding payout-in then terror-corridor IP access
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D3 (Wire / ACH / EFT & cross-border payment data (incl. EMT, P2P, remittance)), not currently held → source data first.

build_logic.logic: Flag behavioural patterns consistent with scam victimization or vulnerable-customer exploitation â out-of-pattern payments to new beneficiaries, escalating transfer sequences to investment or romance-typed payees â escalating when the customer falls in a vulnerable segment.
build_logic.window: rolling 30 days per emerging payee relationship
build_logic.source: payment ledger + customer vulnerability segment + payee risk reference
build_logic.route: Tier-1 alert â fraud/AML & customer-protection review gate

indicators.section: Red Flag Indicators — Iran-backed terrorist orgs
indicators.flag: A customer company is incorporated in the United States or a third-country jurisdiction, but its activities occur solely in jurisdictions known for, or at high risk for, terrorist activity and show no relationship to the company’s stated business purpose.
indicators.red_flag: Domicile-vs-activity mismatch — incorporated locally, operates only in terror corridor
indicators.rationale: Gap; requires D8 (KYC / CDD & beneficial-ownership data), not currently held → source data first.

build_logic.logic: Flag a business account whose transaction inflows are disproportionate to its declared revenue, headcount, payroll, or operating-expense footprint relative to industry peers, escalating when revenue appears decoupled from any observable operational activity.
build_logic.window: rolling 90 days vs declared profile and peer cohort
build_logic.source: business deposit ledger joined to KYC business profile + industry peer benchmarks
build_logic.route: Tier-2 alert â AML analyst review gate
